rho_reference.protocol: PROTOCOL.md §5 H5: rho-frob (rho.signed_frobenius_full, the signed-Frobenius fold), same session, paired by target; rho-strong also measured
rho_reference.binary_or_process: ecbench f7ac8fb01b45613f5ce1d63a7da7c97bd410aa0912cf7b2b15fc203b2bb0e191, one session per curve, both arms interleaved
rho_reference.scope: The band numbers are mean S on icv1-f2m29-tm40309-30c52b96 (n29, c = 1), the one curve on which the protocol ranks the IC arm ahead of rho-frob (`ecbench band --ranks`). n13 is unresolved inside the band; at n17, n23, n31 and n37 rho-frob is ahead at every weight; at n19 the band does not re-price the IC natives (no pinned calibration row). At c = 1 the IC arm is a Frobenius-folded baby-step giant-step and the crossing rests on rho-frob set-up at log2 r = 15.4 (REPORT.pdf).

ecbench_band.what: the protocol-named instrument (band.rs): IC calibration-priced and unpriced natives at w; rho_full natives stay at full_prices.json

like_for_like.what: analysis/core_band.jq: the same native operation types on both arms (canonicalisations, lookups and guard probes, Frobenius maps, row ops, inversions, solves; rho canonicalisations and distinguished points) at w; group work at 1 GAE

every_unit_operation.what: validator diagnostic validation/alike_band.jq: every native unit operation of the full-price rules at w, including field squarings, hash probes, point negations and the factor-base byte floor, which only the IC records count at that granularity
every_unit_operation.order: unresolved (ic < rho at w = 0 and 0.1, rho < ic at w = 1)
